title: outside a git checkout the project fails, the machine checks still print and the project checks are left out
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). Run from the sandbox HOME (no git checkout) doctor exits 3 and prints `fail project: <dir> is not inside a git checkout`, still prints `ok   binary: ...` and the other machine checks, and prints no line for the project checks (no `catalog:` line). Nothing goes to stderr. The oracle has no `doctor` command: it answers `unknown command "doctor"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every pinned line FAILS on it.

stdout.regex: (?m)^fail project: .* is not inside a git checkout$
